parameters.toolDescription: Opens a scrollable product grid — a category, a whole shop or their saved items — with picture, price and buy button on every card. Sends its own button. USE IT WHEN: The customer wants to BROWSE a whole shop, a category or their saved items, or asks to see everything after a page of cards. For a KIND of product ("shoes", "phones", "something for my kitchen"), find them with Search-Products first, then open the grid with their ids in productIds. NOT THIS TOOL: Not for a specific question with a short answer — five cards via Show-Products are better. Not for one product (inapp_open_product). ⚠ Never put a kind of product in q: q matches WHOLE WORDS in titles, tags and descriptions, so "shoes" does not find a "Nike Air Max 90" and the customer opens an empty grid. ⚠ Never describe the button in your own words — the customer would read it twice.
